new: Management v2 is now a complete capability combining Processes, Entware Services, File Manager, Maintenance, and Terminal.
File Manager now provides Commander/Explorer, tree, volumes, UTF-8 editor, create/move/rename/delete/download, properties, and visual chmod inside canonical /opt and /tmp.
Terminal now provides Entware shell and a hardware-validated Keenetic NDM Console backed by fixed server-side ndmc.
System/Thermal/Storage/Network are consolidated into routerforge-monitoring with migration compatibility sockets/APIs.
DNS remains an independent Module ABI v1 runtime with resolver control, observability, client attribution, route-aware diagnostics, and verified rollback.
App Center combines RouterForge, Integrations, and Entware/OPKG with guarded lifecycle jobs, bulk update, and exact release-index/SHA256 verification.
Generic Runtime Web UI Discovery finds local Entware Web UIs without blind LAN scanning.
Stable 0.7.1 is published for ARM64, MIPS, and MIPSel; ARM64 is production and non-ARM64 remains experimental.
MIPSel now has partial physical evidence on Keenetic Giga KN-1010.
fixes: DNS event rings use compact internal representation while preserving the public API and 10,000-event logical retention.
DNS passive capture applies kernel BPF filtering before userspace processing.
Expensive DNS/Monitoring ndmc paths use bounded TTL/last-good caches and failure backoff.
GET /api/catalog remains cached while guarded refresh is same-origin, singleflight, and rate-limited.
Core/Admin/Monitoring polling uses serial scheduling without overlap.
Frontend reads use bounded AbortController timeouts while DNS mutation timeout semantics avoid false failures after possible commits.
Thermal uses stale-while-revalidate/singleflight and storage Statfs is platform-specific.
App Center refreshes Registry state correctly after actions, performs bulk update reliably, and separates update checks.
Finished App Center jobs and failed-login clients now have bounded retention.
Core HTTP has read/header/idle/header-size limits without a global SSE-breaking WriteTimeout.
Core module proxy bounds mutation request bodies before Unix-socket forwarding.
Management theme/Maintenance/File Properties/Terminal now consistently use semantic rf tokens.
Monitoring migration verifier accepts Entware Status: install <selection> installed instead of assuming install ok installed.
READMEs and active documentation are synchronized with Stable 0.7.1; CI checks current-doc invariants and local Markdown links.
Beta builder fail-closed validates release_version/component/min_core train consistency.
compatibility: ARM64 aarch64-3.10 is the fully hardware-validated Stable target.
MIPSel mipsel-3.4 remains experimental with partial KN-1010 physical validation.
MIPS mips-3.4 remains experimental without physical hardware validation.
routerforge-monitoring Provides/Conflicts/Replaces legacy split monitoring packages and historical dns-monitor variants.
Fresh Stable bootstrap installs Core; optional capabilities are selected from App Center.
Stable 0.6.x upgrades through the Stable bootstrap plus App Center.
technical: Keenetic NDM Console passed hardware validation on Keenetic Ultra KN-1812: exact package, ndmc, both browser PTYs, and mode switching.
Monitoring 4→1 migration passed ARM64 hardware validation including reboot/autostart.
Core remains the only RouterForge LAN listener on :2233; modules use root-owned Unix sockets.
Keenetic terminal backend accepts only a mode enum and resolves fixed ndmc itself.
Management mutations require live root session, same-origin, confirmation/whitelist, and a Core-injected internal marker.
File Manager approved roots /opt and /tmp use canonical containment/revalidation.
Profiling remains loopback-only on 127.0.0.1:6061.
FULL RELEASE builds the Stable promotion artifact on the exact dev SHA and main promotion uses that same SHA.
Stable publishes 5 packages × 3 targets = 15 IPKs plus indexes/SHA256/bootstrap.
Immutable routerforge-v0.7.1 is never clobbered.
